spans.s: लेप् vt. 1Ā (pres. लेपते) To go, to move.

लेप m. 1. Anointing, smearing, plastering, Yaj.i.188; 2. unguent, ointment; 3. plaster of any kind; 4. food; 5. the wipings of the hand after offering funeral oblations to the first three ancestors; (these wipings are offered to the three paternal ancestors immediately preceding the Sapiṇḍas) (in law), (लेपभाजश्चतुर्थाद्याः पित्राद्याः पिंडभागिनः); 6. defilement, pollution, impurity; 7. sin.
लेप-कर m. a plaster-maker, a whitewasher.
लेप-भागिन्, -भुज् m. paternal ancestor in the fourth, fifth, or sixth degree.
लेप-भागिन्, -भुज् m. paternal ancestor in the fourth, fifth, or sixth degree.
लेपक m. A plasterer, a whitewasher.
लेपन (II) n. 1. Besmearing, plastering, Yaj.i.188; 2. a plaster, an ointment; 3. flesh.
लेप्य m. Making models, modelling, moulding.
लेप्य-मयी f. a doll, a puppet.
लेप्य-स्त्री f. a woman covered with unguents.
